column1: # Volt's English glossary, seeded from the localization inventory's starter glossary (english-and-safety).
# D3 (terminology cleanup) finalizes it. Columns: id, English term, definition, part of speech, do-not-translate
# (yes/no), safety flag (a volt:safety value or -), source location (src/com/jjricks/volt/ unless a path is given).

column3: definition
The app's name. Never translated.
The scooter maker. Keep the name exactly as written.
The only in-app disclaimer ("Volt <ver> · not affiliated with NAVEE"). A translation must not soften "not affiliated".
NAVEE's own app. Translate "official app" the same way everywhere; keep "NAVEE".
The connected e-scooter. Pick one word and use it everywhere.
The account role the scooter grants to its owner, as opposed to shared access.

column2: shared access; shared user; shared role
column3: A role the owner grants to another account.

column2: owner identity (also owner key, setup key, scooter key)
column3: The 12-hex-character credential Volt authenticates with. The source uses four names; D3 picks one target term. Treat it as a secret.

column2: owner setup; owner setup file; capture; capture helper
column3: Getting the owner identity from the NAVEE app. The file name navee-owner-setup.json and setup/capture-owner.py stay as written.
Third-party app name.
Android Debug Bridge; keep the name.
Google's command-line tools package; keep the name.
Android's setting. Use Android's own localized wording.
Android's settings page. Use Android's own localized wording.
Android's About phone entry. Use Android's own localized wording ("Settings › About phone").
Volt's lock control and its states. Locked and unlocked must stay clearly distinct.
The lock row on Home.

column2: Lock state unverified; lock state unknown
column3: Volt could not confirm the lock state. Must never read as confirmed.
How long the scooter stays locked when off.

column2: handlebar PIN (also fallback PIN, dashboard PIN)
column3: The 4-digit code entered on the handlebar. The source uses three names; D3 picks one.
Unlocking when the paired phone is near.
Bluetooth bonding. The UI says "pair" and the code says "bond"; use "pair" in the UI.

column2: Connect; Disconnect; Connection details; Signal lost
column3: Bluetooth link actions and states.
Stationary; some changes require it.
The numeric model code the scooter advertises. Keep the term "Model ID" and the number.
The scooter's software. Volt never changes it.

column2: compatibility check; compatibility checker; compatibility report
column3: A read-only check and an emailed report. The UI is translated; the report content stays English.

column2: Report an issue; Diagnostics; diagnostics file
column3: An email to Volt with an English attachment.

column2: Experimental controls (internal id Lab; card title Untested controls)
column3: Controls the official app does not offer, or that Volt has not verified on this model. D3 resolves the three names.

column2: Try; Set back; Help verify; Unverified; Untested; Unconfirmed; Refused by scooter; Worked here
column3: Outcomes of an experimental try. "Unconfirmed" means the scooter acknowledged but the value was not kept or read back.
Whether the scooter reported the new value. Unverified or unknown must never read as confirmed.

How hard the motor accelerates.
